text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a console/frontend deploy tomorrow 09:30 PT. ~20m window. Small header/nav CSS tweak + asset version bump. I will drive the deploy.

sam: cool, who's on smoke? I'll be on-call.

maya: thanks — @sam you're primary smoke. @leo can you stand by for rollback?

leo: yep, I'll be around. what's the CDN plan? full purge or path invalidate?

maya: Cloudflare cache keys — we'll do a targeted invalidate for the build prefix then soft purge for everything else as fallback. Steps: 1) ship assets -> new BUILD_ID 2) call `curl -I https://console.redwood.com/_static/BUILD_ID/manifest.json` to confirm file served 3) Cloudflare API invalidate `POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/<ZONE>/purge_cache` with `{ "files": ["https://console.redwood.com/_static/BUILD_ID/*"] }` 4) wait 60s and smoke.

taylor: can you paste the exact curl + API snippet you plan to run so I can copy?

maya: sure — small snippet:```
# verify asset presence
curl -I https://console.redwood.com/_static/BUILD_ID/manifest.json

# cloudflare purge (replace token/zone)
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE/purge_cache" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"files":["https://console.redwood.com/_static/BUILD_ID/*"]}'
```

sam: good. what's the smoke checklist? minimal steps I should run.

maya: quick smoke checklist (order):
- hit console root and confirm header renders (desktop + mobile)
- login as test user and list a few projects
- open workspace heavy page (list + large graph) for 30s to catch mem/JS errors
- run sample search + result click -> verify trace shows no 500s
- check embed/iframe assets if your route hits them
- check Sentry + tracing for new errors (last 15m)

leo: if we see a regression, rollback plan?

maya: rollback plan: 1) flip canary routing back to previous tag (we keep previous build pinned in the deploy pipeline) 2) trigger deployment job to re-promote previous BUILD_ID to prod 3) purge Cloudflare for the previous BUILD_ID if any stale assets served 4) alert channel and mark rollback in release notes. Full steps documented in the release playbook.

dev-prod-bot: Deploy window reserved by @maya for 2026-03-18 09:30 PT — auto-reminder 10m prior.

sam: I'll run the checklist and post results here. plan to be on-call for 30m post-deploy. :thumbsup:

maya: perfect — I'll start the pipeline at 09:30 PT, tagging as `release/console/2026-03-18`. ping here when pipeline hits prod artifacts.

taylor: noted. I'll monitor graphs and perf dashboards.

maya: thanks all — short and smooth. if anything blocks we'll abort and escalate.
